def gen_move(cond, repl, tag="M", castle_pat=r"(\S+)", ep_match=r"\S+", newep="-"):
    bp, groups = board_pat(cond)
    br, n = board_repl(groups, repl)
    pat = r"(?m)^P:" + bp + " " + castle_pat + " " + ep_match + "$"
    rep = r"\g<0>" + "\n" + tag + ":" + br + " " + r"\g<%d>" % (n + 1) + " " + newep
    add(pat, rep)
